reviews.text: Virginie is a very professional, kind, and attentive groomer. She gives excellent advice and knows perfectly how to adapt to my poodle's coat. I had the opportunity to spend a day shadowing this groomer.

This experience allowed me to discover the daily life of the profession and observe the work of a passionate professional. She demonstrates great expertise and pays particular attention to the well-being of the animals.

What some owners may not appreciate is that she is very frank and direct in her advice. However, it's important to understand that each of her decisions is made in the animal's best interest. Her goal is not only to achieve a beautiful aesthetic result, but above all to respect the dog's well-being and limitations.

For example, when a dog has never been groomed or is particularly anxious, she always prioritizes a suitable and respectful approach rather than forcing a service for purely aesthetic reasons. In my opinion, this is proof of true professionalism.

It's important to remember that every animal is different. Some dogs and cats experience grooming very calmly, while others can be stressed by new noises, smells, the environment, or handling. That's why it's important to gradually accustom your pet to grooming from a young age if you want them to be groomed regularly throughout their life.

It's also important to remember that each coat type and breed has its own specific needs. When a groomer refuses certain requests, it's not due to a lack of skill, but rather out of respect for the animal's needs and the characteristics of its coat. A good professional always prioritizes the animal's health and comfort over any aesthetic considerations.

Virginie is a competent, passionate professional who is deeply attentive to animal welfare.

I sincerely thank her for her warm welcome and the time she dedicated to me.

I highly recommend this salon! And what's more, the prices are fair and reasonable. Thank you so much to her; it's so important to leave your furry friend without worry and to come back happy and looking beautiful!

An absolutely catastrophic experience from beginning to end. I deeply regret entrusting my dog ​​to this salon. I have never seen such a lack of professionalism and so little consideration for animal welfare.

The reception was cold and unpleasant, the atmosphere extremely stressful, and the grooming was performed without any gentleness or patience. My dog ​​left anxious, and the result was clearly botched: sloppy finishing touches, no attention paid to requests, and work far below standard.

What shocked me most was the total lack of empathy and kindness. When you work with animals, the very least you can do is have patience, respect, and a modicum of humanity. Here, I found none of these qualities.

I left disgusted, shocked, and extremely disappointed by this appalling experience. I strongly advise anyone who truly cares about their pet's well-being against going to this salon: avoid it at all costs. Fortunately, there are groomers who are far more competent, humane, and respectful.
